context: A small bug with mass m crawls on a rotating disk. Its path relative to the disk is a circle of radius R, and the disk rotates with angular velocity omega. Discover the maximum contact force required to maintain the motion.

input_variables.m: Mass of the bug in kilograms.
input_variables.omega: Angular velocity in radians per second.

output_variable.F_max: Maximum force between the bug and the disk in newtons.

context: A fox runs along a straight line while a hound pursues it at a constant speed. Discover the hound's acceleration scale from the two speeds and the initial separation.
A charge is placed in an isotropic linear dielectric medium under a uniform external electric field. Discover the force scale from charge, field, and relative permittivity.
An adiabatic cylinder has cross-sectional area S and initial gas volume V_0. Discover the displacement scale after the prescribed thermodynamic process.
Two relativistic particles with rest mass M form a bound system. Discover the characteristic emitted energy from mass and light speed.
An incompressible viscous fluid flows through a slender channel under a pressure difference. Discover the volume flow rate from radius, pressure drop, viscosity, and length.
